description: Start a new build of an index whose last build failed, once the cause is fixed (failed builds are never retried by themselves). An index that isn't failed is refused with INDEX_BUILD_NOT_FAILED. With wait: true this polls until it's built, 1 request per poll. 1 request, plus the polls.

index.description: The index: its id or pathName

list.description: The list: its id or pathName

wait.description: Wait (up to 30 seconds) for the build to finish, polling with metered requests

name: rebuild_index
title: Rebuild a failed index
